coverage.method: Director Compensation tables from every definitive proxy filed 2019-2026 (DEF 14A 2019-04-12, 2020-04-10, 2021-04-09, 2022-04-08, 2023-04-14, 2024-04-19, 2025-04-17, 2026-04-16), one table per calendar fiscal year FY2018-FY2025: 74 rows (7, 8, 9, 7, 8, 8, 13, 14). The FY2018-FY2020 tables have Fees Earned or Paid in Cash, Stock Awards and Total columns; FY2021-FY2025 add All Other Compensation (director personal security and tax gross-ups). Missing columns and printed dashes are recorded as 0, and every row's components equal its printed total. Employee directors (Zuckerberg; Sandberg through 2022-09-30; Koum through May 2018) are excluded by the proxies; Sandberg's Q4 2022 director pay is in the Summary Compensation Table only (see open_questions). Meta filed no 10-K/A in the period. Checked with no director table: the DEFA14A notices and supplements (2019-04-12 x2, 2020-04-10, 2020-05-13 committee supplement, 2021-04-09, 2022-04-08, 2023-04-14, 2023-05-16 image-only voting-recommendation deck, 2024-04-19, 2025-04-17, 2026-04-16), the 2020 and 2022 DEF 14C information statements, and the 2024 PRE 14A (preliminary version of the 2024 proxy, not recorded). Policy changes are dated from the 2020 and 2021 annual meeting 8-Ks. No proxy or 8-K disclosed a settlement, clawback or recoupment of director pay. Directors not in meta_board_research.json (Bowles, Desmond-Hellmann, Hastings, all departed in 2019) get CIKs from their 2018-06-19 Form 4s.
